How to Prevent Cavities

Cavities form when plaque acids wear away tooth enamel. The good news: a few consistent habits go a long way toward prevention.

Brush twice a day

Use fluoride toothpaste and brush for two minutes, morning and night.

Floss daily

Flossing removes plaque between teeth that a brush cannot reach.

Watch your diet

Limit sugary snacks and drinks, which feed the bacteria that cause decay.

If you already have a cavity, our dental implants page covers options for more advanced tooth loss.
